extracted.name: Easy Arugula Salad
extracted.description: Let this simple arugula salad take your main dish to stellar heights! With Parmesan, tomatoes, avocado, and pine nuts, it's quick, easy, and delicious!
ingredient_lines: 4 cups young arugula leaves, rinsed and dried
2 tablespoons grapeseed oil or olive oil
1 large avocado - peeled, pitted and sliced
instruction_lines: Combine arugula, tomatoes, pine nuts, Parmesan, oil, and vinegar in a large, lidded plastic bowl. Season with salt and pepper, then cover with the lid and shake to mix.
Divide salad onto serving plates and top with avocado slices.
